text: りゅうじん　さまの　ほねを　おがめる　とは！

structure.jp: りゅうじん　さまの　ほねを

structure.en: to think I can behold them!

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a sentence shows surprise or emotion at what it states. おがめる　とは = 'to think I get to behold it!'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: おがめる is the can-do form of おがむ (to worship, behold). おがめる = 'can behold'.
